SRR01.required_question: Does the package bind byte-exactly to Decision 0090 and all Formalization V1 author-candidate artifacts, with no post-checkpoint semantic modification?
SRR01.title: Package integrity and exact artifact binding

SRR02.required_question: Is the formalization correctly based on the reviewed 531 leaf records, 109 semantic units, 57 matrix field classes, and 171 Schema-V2 carrier paths, with the raw 642-scalar V4 traversal explicitly excluded as domain authority?
SRR02.title: Authoritative reviewed-domain correctness

SRR03.required_question: Does the formalization correctly preserve the non-equivalence between the semantic-unit field-class vocabulary and field_class_analysis.v4_field_class, without merging, equating, or silently translating the two domains?
SRR03.title: Two distinct 57-element vocabularies

SRR04.required_question: Are all 9,747 pairs accounted for with exactly 113 SEMANTICALLY_RELATED, 969 NOT_SEMANTICALLY_RELATED, and 8,665 UNRESOLVED, with 125 lexical-only pairs left unresolved, absence from prior screening not treated as negative proof, and semantic_accounting used only as the explicit negative basis?
SRR04.title: Conservative 9,747-pair classification policy

SRR05.required_question: Are all 531 reviewed leaf records and all 109 semantic units preserved and correctly bound to reviewed unit-analysis evidence, while carrier-family expansion remains screening context rather than automatic semantic-relatedness classification?
SRR05.title: Leaf, unit, and carrier-family traceability

SRR06.required_question: Is PARTIAL_RELATION_FURTHER_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED the strongest supported author-candidate result, without claiming a proven positive existing-V2 mapping path, a proven negative mapping impossibility, or admissible-composition exhaustiveness?
SRR06.title: Bounded technical interpretation

SRR07.required_question: Does the formalization preserve the reviewed admissibility boundaries, including no opaque semantic packing, no hidden free-text semantic storage, no unrelated-field repurposing, no semantic_accounting as semantic storage, and no silent strengthening or weakening?
SRR07.title: Admissibility and nonclaim preservation

SRR08.required_question: Is the author-candidate formalization reproducibly verifiable with the safe verifier, are retired verifiers kept retired, and does the package avoid authorizing operational mapping, schema-successor work, curl.json, analyzer, baseline, or repair?
SRR08.title: Governance boundary and reproducibility
